                                                    DOCKET NO. 59611


 APPLICATION OF EL PASO                                            §   PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION
 ELECTRIC COMPANY FOR APROVAL                                      §
 OF A HIGH LOAD FACTOR LARGE                                       §           OF TEXAS
 POWER SERVICE TARIFF                                              §


                            ORDER NO. 1
   REQUIRING COMMENTS AND RECOMMENDATIONS ON THE APPLICATION,
  PROPOSED NOTICE, AND APPROPRIATE PROCESSING OF THE APPLICATION

          This Order addresses application filed by El Paso Electric Company (EPE) on April 7,
2026, for approval of a new tariff applicable to very large, high load factor customers. EPE
proposes to create Schedule No. 27 - High Load Factor Large Power Service Rate (HLFLP) with
an effective date of May 12, 2026. EPE also proposes the termination of Rate Schedule 33A upon
approval of the proposed Schedule No. 27.

          EPE proposes that notice be given to Anthony, Clint, El Paso, Horizon City, San Elizario,
Socorro, Van Horn, and Vinton, the municipalities retaining original jurisdiction over EPE’s rates,
by service of a copy of the application and by a one-time publication in newspapers of general
circulation in EPE’s service territory. By April 22, 2026, Commission Staff must file comments
and recommendations on the administrative completeness of the application and notice, and a
proposal, including schedule, for the appropriate processing of this docket.

          Signed at Austin, Texas, on the 8th day of April 2026.
                                                                PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION OF TEXAS




                                                                ERIC YOON
                                                                ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGE
